contributions.detail: Form A is an EMPTY SCHEDULE by the filer's own hand: one long diagonal stroke runs corner to corner across the whole sheet and a large 'N' and 'A' are drawn over the grid (N/A). Under core §3(f) this is a struck-out schedule - zero rows, not a row and not a zero-valued transaction. Cover line 1 reads 0 in all three columns (hand-drawn O glyphs), which is consistent. The Carr form prints no schedule total. LAST = THIS = CUM = 0, so the scopes coincide.

NOTE the filer wrote the SAME figure 3,665.03 in ALL THREE cover columns of line 3, so the cover's LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE identity does NOT hold here (3,665.03 + 3,665.03 != 3,665.03). Both/all three printed figures are retained verbatim; nothing was recomputed. The rows equal the CUMULATIVE cell, so scope is cumulative. The FORM prints no schedule total; the 3665.03 in schedule_total is the FILER's hand-written one.
